notes.title: Your Adventure just got even more upgraded!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
After a long time without any news and updates from us, because we were in a small hiatus while doing many great upgrades for this game!

This update now is all about the Visuals, many scenes have been upgraded with new visuals, a better enviroment interraction with the characters, a better Skybox and many, many more, but there is also some Performance improvement and the Combat System got a revamp! Now it's working way better than how it worked in the past!

The next update that will take sometime to get released will be all about the story and some enemy AI upgrades, sadlly I can give a exact date as to when this update will happen, BUT say tunned to our social medias and you will get weekly updates about how the changes in the game are working and going!

For now here I'll give everyone a detailed changeset of this update

- All of the Fields got an upgrade on the visuals
- All of the characters got a new Combat System
- Aleister, Naga and Wendi got their design changed
- The Loadings of the game are working even faster now
- We are not using LOD in almost everywhere in the game
- FPS improvements
- 80% of the enemies got their design changed (The 20% rest of the enemies will have their designs changed in the next update)
- Added two extra cutscenes that were supossed to had comeout in the last update, but it didn't
- Now you can open the map both in the Pause Menu and in the normal game! To open it on the game without the pause menu just press M on the keyboard or select on the controller!
- Now you have the option to see the FPS Counter in the game
- Now you have the option to leave the camera free when walking, it won't be locked vertically anymore!

notes.title: Your journey just got upgraded!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is the 1rst of 4 big updates that we are going to do for Miriel Saga now that the game is fully finished. 
This updates are basically for big performace improvements, story upgrades (Basically putting some more cutscenes that we couldn't put in the full game) and big design upgrades. 
And starting from this upgrade we are going to give you some small updates every 1 month and big update every 3 or 4 months. So with this we plan to continue improving Miriel Saga until it reaches 1 year of release!

Now I'll say what are the changes and improvements that we made on this update

Additions:
- New Design for Fiora
- 3 new cutscenes on the Prologue Chapter
- 3 new cutscenes on the 1rst Chapter
- New Particle Effect on Aleister's Attack Buff
- Upgrades to Aleister's Katana, Lilluza's Big Sword and Naga's Bow

Changes:
- Improved load times
- Some Cutscenes now have more smooth transitions to a cutscene continuation in another map
- Performance improvements on Accord, School Campus, Field 1, Field 2 and Woodville
- New grass on Field 1 and 2

notes.title: The end of a journey means the beginning of another
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is going to be our last update of the game! So, it means that today the game is finally fully done! But there is no reason to be sad, the game isn't going to be abandoned by us, we will still update it to take out some bugs, and depending on the number of copys sold we are going to make some free updates adding more endings to the game and adding more bosses and playable characters! But we are going to talk about this goals later in this post, for now I'll talk about the fixed and upgrades that this version has, but before you start playing the game I highly recomend that you don't use your old save file, it's better to start a new one, since many things were added to the game.

Updates and Fixes:

- Added the 5 and final Chapter of the game
- Added 6 more bosses
- Added the Final Dungeon
- Added many Collab NPC's
- Added conversations with many NPC's
- The player can't walk on water anymore
- Added more tutorials
- Added new special enemies on all the Fields
- Added a new Field
- Improved a lot the performance of the game
- Added more information the the Minimap
- Added more Special Attacks to the Characters
- Added a Secret Very Hard Boss
- Fixed bugs involving Cutscenes
- Added a New EXP System 
- Added more ways to use your in-game money
- Added 4 more cutscenes on Old Chapters
- Fixed many bugs involving cutscenes and the player taking damage

Goals:

Now that the game is fully complete and finished we will set some goals in case of the game selling a x number of copies.

If the game sells:

100 Copies - We are going to add a Bad Ending to the game.
500 Copies - We are going to add a Bad Ending, True Ending, One (1) more Playable Character, Two (2) new Bosses to the game.

notes.title: The Last Big Update before the Full release of the game
notes.content:
This update has:
- Many bug fixes
- Intro Cutscene was added
- Chapter 4 is now fully working and aviable to play
- A new Moveset for Aleister
- Many performance upgrades
- A completely new UI
- Faster loadtimes
- Many Cutscene improvements

notes.title: At the Storm's End
notes.content:
Another year comes to a close. If has been chaotic and difficult for everyone, including ourselves. Still, we gathered every ounce of strength and dedication to bring this project steps further and to what we're sure to be one of the final steps to our project. Our most recend update is out and we wanted to thank everyone for sticking with us one more year, through the ups and downs. 

On this update, we've made many improvements, were made, such as:

- The 4rd Chapter of the Story of Miriel Saga
- Enemies AI improvement
- Combat System Improvement
- More and Improved Tutorials
- New drives and Overdrives for some of the characters
- Side Quests
- 8 new scenarios
- Aleister has a transformation now
- New Enemies 
- A New Moveset for Aleister
- Improvments to the Saving and Loading of the game
- Many bug fixes
- Some UI elements are updated
- Full suport for both XBOX Controllers and Keyboard and Mouse
- A New Voice Actress for Lilluza
- A new fully voiced Cutscene
- A new mini game
- Two new music tracks

The storm isn't over yet...but for everyone of us, we hope to start the new year in a new light, stronger and as unscathed as possible.

And hey, almost 1 month from now I'll update the game again, with more visual upgrades and more combat upgrades, so stay tunned and hyped! ;)
